# sonrai_custom_controls (Data Source)

Lists the custom controls defined in the organization, with the permissions each covers and where it is deployed under a root scope.

Custom controls belong to the whole organization, so the list includes ones made in the console and by other configurations. Use it to see what exists before defining one with `sonrai_custom_control`, which rejects a name that is already taken, and to find where a control is still deployed before destroying it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every custom control in the organization, including ones made in the console.
data "sonrai_custom_controls" "all" {
  root_scope = "aws/r-abcd"
}

output "custom_controls" {
  value = {
    for c in data.sonrai_custom_controls.all.controls : c.control_key => {
      title       = c.title
      permissions = c.permissions
    }
  }
}

# Controls still deployed somewhere under the root scope. One of these cannot
# be destroyed until it has been detached from the scopes listed and that
# change deployed.
output "custom_controls_in_use" {
  value = {
    for c in data.sonrai_custom_controls.all.controls : c.control_key => c.deployed_scopes
    if length(c.deployed_scopes) > 0
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `root_scope` (String) Cloud organization root scope, for example `aws/r-abcd`. It selects the cloud whose controls are listed, and `deployed_scopes` reports deployments under it.

### Read-Only

- `control_keys` (Set of String) Just the control keys.
- `controls` (Attributes List) Every custom control, sorted by control key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--controls))
- `id` (String) Same as `root_scope`.

<a id="nestedatt--controls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `controls`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_type` (String)
- `control_key` (String) Key to give `sonrai_account_protected_service` or `sonrai_account_disabled_service` to attach the control.
- `deployed_resource_ids` (List of String) Cloud-native id of each entry in `deployed_scopes`, in the same order: what resources take as `resource_id`.
- `deployed_scopes` (List of String) Scope paths under `root_scope` where the control is deployed. A control staged at a scope and not yet deployed is not listed. Empty means the control can be destroyed as far as this root scope is concerned.
- `description` (String)
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions the control covers, as the platform spells them.
- `title` (String)
